source: Supplied compact SwimComposer teaching video and race data
timeMapping: source video time = exercise time + 5.0 s; no trimmed media file is created

processing.smoothing: centered Gaussian: distance sigma 0.60 s, screen x sigma 0.16 s, edge replication; distance nondecreasing clamp
processing.playback: monotone cubic interpolation at render time
processing.videoY: fixed lane centerline; no detected vertical bounce
processing.rank: rank by smoothed estimated distance; source rank provided separately
processing.geometry: static approximate regions; not calibrated pool or camera geometry

limits: Estimated data. Static approximate screen geometry. Not official ranks or camera-calibrated coordinates.
